title.narrative: Strengthening Ukraine’s resilience – Mine Action and Rescue Service (MARS)

description.narrative: The project “Strengthening Ukraine’s Resilience – Mine Action and Rescue Service (MARS)” started on 18 August 2024. The project consists of two components, where the first focuses on support to the rescue services with the State Emergency Service of Ukraine (SESU), as the partner. Component 1 is specifically aimed at strengthening capacity to respond to CBRN incidents (i.e., chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear events) as well as supporting SESU in achieving EU civil protection standards that will enable Ukraine’s EU accession. The second component of the MARS project aims to strengthen the capacity of Ukrainian authorities to address the enormous challenges posed by mines, improvised explosive devices (IEDs), and unexploded ordnance in Ukraine. The National Police (NPU) and the State Special Transport Service (SSTS) are the main bilateral recipients of the support.
